claims.text: Started in 1927 by Thomas Parnell of the University of Queensland
claims.quote: was started in 1927 by Thomas Parnell of the University of Queensland

claims.text: Purpose: show students that some solid-looking substances are viscous fluids
claims.quote: to demonstrate to students that some substances which appear solid are highly viscous fluids

claims.text: Parnell poured heated pitch into a sealed funnel and let it settle three years
claims.quote: Parnell poured a heated sample of the pitch into a sealed funnel and allowed it to settle for three years

claims.text: In 1930 the funnel neck was cut and pitch started flowing
claims.quote: In 1930, the seal at the neck of the funnel was cut, allowing the pitch to start flowing

claims.text: Each drop forms and falls over about a decade
claims.quote: Each droplet forms and falls over a period of about a decade

claims.text: Pitch viscosity about 230 billion times water
claims.quote: a viscosity of approximately 230 billion times that of water

claims.text: Glass dome, on display outside a lecture theatre
claims.quote: A glass dome covers the funnel and it is placed on display outside a lecture theatre

claims.text: Mainstone supervised from 1961 to 2013

claims.text: Seventh drop fell 3 July 1988

claims.text: No one witnessed the 1988 drop fall

claims.text: Mainstone stepped out for a drink at that moment
